in_marathi.name: Satendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Truth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Satendra is a Sanskrit name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sat' meaning truth and 'Indra' meaning Lord. It is the name of Lord Indra, the Hindu god of rain, thunder, and the sky. Satendra is revered as the protector of truth and wisdom, and is invoked to bring prosperity and success.
